bias.label: Leaning down below 3,550-3,560; bigger trend down

event: Today (Wed 25 Nov) 15:30 SAST: US October PCE inflation, personal income and spending, and Q3 GDP. Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut. Fed decision Wed 9 Dec.

bullets.title: New 15-month low
bullets.text: Gold slipped to about 3,527 by 09:47 SAST after an intraday low near 3,512, the lowest since September 2025.

bullets.title: Hike almost certain
bullets.text: CME FedWatch prices a 96.4% chance of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December, up from 95% a day earlier.

bullets.title: Strong dollar
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 104, close to a 19-20 month high, and the US 10-year yield is near 4.90% (UNVERIFIED, untimed quote).

bullets.title: Margins raised
bullets.text: CME raised gold futures margins from 5% to 6% after Tuesday's close, which can force more selling.

bullets.title: Oversold readings
bullets.text: RSI is near 29-32 on the charts analysts cite, so a sharp bounce is possible even inside the downtrend.

bullets.title: PCE is the test
bullets.text: Core PCE is expected at +0.3% m/m and 3.2% y/y at 15:30 SAST; a hot number could break 3,500, a soft one could spark a bounce.

bullets.title: Risks in background
bullets.text: Ship attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and new US tariff plans are in the news but have not stopped the slide.
